# onpager_group_membership (Resource)

Manage one manual group membership source for an existing user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "onpager_group_membership" "example" {
  group_id = var.group_id
  user_id  = var.user_id
}

variable "group_id" {
  description = "Existing custom group UUID; All Users is derived and unsupported."
  type        = string
}

variable "user_id" {
  description = "Existing human user UUID; this source does not change the profile."
  type        = string
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Custom group UUID. Changing it replaces the resource. The derived All Users group cannot be managed. Must be a nonzero canonical lowercase UUID.
- `user_id` (String) Existing human user UUID. Changing it replaces the manual source. This resource does not create users or manage OIDC-derived membership. Must be a nonzero canonical lowercase UUID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Explicit manual source identity `group_uuid/user_uuid`, also used for import. Both components are nonzero canonical lowercase UUIDs.

## Import

Import using `group_uuid/user_uuid`. Import reads the stored manual membership
source. OIDC-derived and All Users membership cannot be imported as manual
membership.

Use an `import` block:

```terraform
import {
  to = onpager_group_membership.example
  id = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
}
```

Or use the CLI:

```shell
terraform import onpager_group_membership.example 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333
```

## Lifecycle

This resource owns one manual group/user membership source. Both UUIDs are
immutable; changing either replaces the resource. The user must already exist as
a human user in the same tenant. The derived All Users group cannot be changed.

Create idempotently ensures the manual source; destroy removes that source.
OIDC-derived membership remains independent. Neither operation changes the group
metadata revision or sends `If-Match`. Removing a membership that supplies the
caller's grants can make later API calls unauthorized.

Refresh and import read the manual source directly. An absent manual source
returns HTTP 404 even if an OIDC-derived membership remains. Only confirmed
absence removes state; authentication, authorization, transport and malformed
responses retain it.

## Permissions

Requires tenant grants `group_memberships.read`, `group_memberships.add` and
`group_memberships.remove`. Service accounts require explicit native grants and
do not inherit human membership.
